coupling: The first edit changes m_lastBufferRequestSize into a one-byte-larger reparse hint after a repeated request for an empty buffer. By itself that hint affects scheduling only. The second edit uses the hint as the consumed byte count when XML_ParseBuffer fills the remaining capacity; with the original exact request size this equals len. Together, a valid 2048-byte fill makes m_bufferEnd point one byte beyond the allocation and the tokenizer reads that byte. Repair requires keeping the heuristic request hint separate from the actual number of bytes supplied to XML_ParseBuffer across the two commit boundaries.
